A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]] seven [[Time/Legends|standard weeks]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Wild Space" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] defended Anoth from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Shortly after the battle, Kenobi and Skywalker once again [[Battle of Bakura (Clone Wars)|fought]] Grievous on the planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
